scope: Admin-only promotion rehearsal/draft UI and read-only order evidence UI in the existing application. Development branch only; no production data, deployment, activation, repair or permission changes.

navigation.legacyFeaturesAndDeepLinks: Preserved; live promotion assignment, pricing, campaign and order actions have different scope from these proposal/review pages.
navigation.protectedWelcome: Uses the unchanged legacy navigation; new entries are added only to the scoped task navigation and command search outside welcome.
navigation.permissions: Admin-only frontend guard before reads; existing backend StaffAuthGuard remains authoritative. No new role grants. Draft owners come from authenticated staff rows. Browser owner keys only partition local recovery data.

routes.notes: Twenty-item UUID cursor; displayed item count is not a global total or completed-work count.

routes.action: Choose product, set offer, rehearse and save a proposal
routes.previewBody: Direct PromotionScenario DTO, without a scenario wrapper

routes.action: Read saved proposal and captured evidence
routes.notes: A saved=requestId query triggers GET /requests/:requestId and identity validation before showing action success; the query alone is never proof.

routes.saveBody: {requestId: UUID, revision: positive integer, scenario: PromotionScenario}

routes.action: Check or safely retry an interrupted save
apis: POST /api/reports/promotion-planning/drafts or PATCH /drafts/:draftId using the original immutable packet
routes.notes: Only a verified 404 permits the same-key retry. Read failure blocks retry; known conflict requires latest-version review. Missing browser packet cannot invent a retry.

routes.action: Look up an order with optional review window
routes.api: None until a valid order UUID is submitted

routes.action: Read comparison, observed findings and coverage
routes.notes: Optional caller-selected pending-send review setting; it is not evidence of a system SLA. Absent setting is not fabricated.

URL policy survives finding links and history. Render whitelisted evidence fields and local existing order link; never navigate to an untrusted proposal link. Missing finding after refresh has a useful empty state.

interactionInvariants: Name, SKU, source-derived selling unit, quantity and offer are validated inline. Count quantities must be whole; measured quantities allow four decimal places. Tier ranges must increase without overlaps.
Fixed discount applies once to the entire line total. Buy/get quantities include buy and get items. Existing tier unit/badge labels and optional minimum margin survive edits.
A changed selling unit resets quantity and requires re-entry; unavailable selling unit prevents rehearsal. No unit conversion or UNKNOWN unit is invented.

Preview is read-only and never treated as saved. A changed form invalidates the previous preview. Cost, stock, capacity, upstream freshness, checkout priorities and stacking remain unknown/incomplete.

Save uses a synchronous click lock and a verified durable per-actor/per-request local journal before dispatch. Storage failure blocks sending. The original key/body/revision is retained for response-loss recovery.

Persisted success requires saved=true, persisted=true, operationalWrites=false, activationAllowed=false, matching scenario/identity and expected revision. Invalid HTTP-200 envelopes are not successful saves.
Back/forward and reload preserve tab-local input; this backup is explicitly not a server draft. A backup from another revision is retained until an explicit latest-version/copy decision.

Observed risks coexist with partial coverage. Unknown sources and empty scopes never establish full order safety. Finding counts reflect returned findings; suggested reviewers are not assignments or completed work.

Labels, inline aria-invalid guidance, loading skeletons, visible sanitized errors/retry, empty/unavailable states, keyboard navigation and mobile task navigation use shared controls and scoped styling.

browserVerification.mode: Built application, native planning controller/input/draft services and native order-review service, fresh owned localhost PostgreSQL tables. Shop snapshot and local identity are synthetic. Real production authentication is not exercised by this harness; separate repository HTTP tests cover guards.
browserVerification.data: Synthetic only; migration applied solely to the owned fixture database. No .env or other-task credentials loaded.
browserVerification.screenshots: Not taken, per user instruction. Geometry/semantic checks do not claim pixel-perfect Stitch matching.

remaining: Authoritative effective cost/COGS, selling-unit stock mapping, capacity, upstream freshness and customer checkout priority/stacking assembly remain missing; this is an incomplete proposal tool, not a profit guarantee or activation flow.
Order source change times, complete shipment/business deadlines and additional authoritative milestones remain unavailable; review findings require humans and do not repair orders.
The draft migration is not applied to production. Production migration/deployment/integration are outside this authorization.

Today inbox, MER comparison/ACL resolution, pack-and-price planning, profit tools, sales/readiness/OCR and BA integration remain separate queue items. No additional queue work was started in this slice.
